items.q: Some people prefer working from home, while others prefer working in an office. Which do you prefer, and why?
items.model: I think working from home is better, for two reasons. First, I can save time because I don't have to commute. For example, I save about two hours every day. Second, I can focus better in a quiet place. So overall, I prefer working from home.

items.q: Is it better to live in a big city or in the countryside? Why?
items.model: I think living in a big city is better, for two reasons. First, there are more job opportunities. For example, many companies have their offices in the city. Second, public transportation is very convenient. So overall, I prefer living in a big city.

items.q: Should students wear school uniforms? Why or why not?
items.model: I think wearing school uniforms is better, for two reasons. First, students don't have to choose clothes every morning. For example, they can save time before school. Second, uniforms help students feel like a team. So overall, I prefer school uniforms.

items.q: Do you think it is better to travel alone or with friends? Why?
items.model: I think traveling with friends is better, for two reasons. First, it's more fun to share experiences. For example, we can talk about the food we tried. Second, it's safer to be with other people. So overall, I prefer traveling with friends.

items.q: For everyday shopping, is it better to use cash or cards? Why?
items.model: I think using cards is better, for two reasons. First, paying is faster. For example, I can just tap my card at the register. Second, I can easily check how much I spent. So overall, I prefer using cards.

items.q: Is it better to read books on paper or on a screen? Why?
items.model: I think reading on paper is better, for two reasons. First, my eyes don't get tired. For example, I can read for hours without a headache. Second, I remember the story better. So overall, I prefer paper books.

items.q: Should companies allow employees to choose their working hours? Why or why not?
items.model: I think flexible working hours are better, for two reasons. First, employees can avoid crowded trains. For example, they can start at ten instead of nine. Second, people work better when they feel less stressed. So overall, I prefer flexible hours.

items.q: Is it better to cook at home or to eat out? Why?

items.q: Should young children have their own smartphones? Why or why not?

items.q: Is it better to take one long vacation a year or several short ones? Why?
